items.title: 3 Oil Stocks Trading At Least 43% Below Future Cash Flow Value
items.summary: Energy markets are jumpy again as the Iran conflict keeps oil supplies in focus and pushes fuel and heating costs higher for households. When everyday bills feel this sensitive to crude prices, investors often start paying closer attention to large oil and gas producers. This article walks through three of the strongest candidates from a global oil and gas screen and explains what makes each worth a closer look. items.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Earnings Beat And Dividend Hike Put Valuation Back In Focus
items.summary: ConocoPhillips (COP) just put fresh numbers on the table with its third quarter 2026 earnings, pairing higher reported revenue and net income with updated production guidance and an 11% dividend increase. That backdrop has kept ConocoPhillips in focus, with the share price up 15.9% over the past 90 days and 40.9% year to date, even though the 7 day share price return declined 11.5% and short term momentum cooled ahead of this earnings release.
